title: Tool-Calling LLM Agents Under Realistic MCP Faults: Scale Does Not Purchase Fault Tolerance
abstract: arXiv:2610.32555v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on external tools exposed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), yet current benchmarks assume tools respond correctly and on time, leaving agent resilience to realistic tool failures untested. We introduce MCP-Injector, a drop-in, protocol-aware fault-injection middleware that interposes on the MCP tool-call path with controlled persistence (permanent, transient, intermittent) and seedable schedules. Its fault model is calibrated to the observed incident distribution (failure mode x persistence) of the public MCP ecosystem, mined from 57,240 issue and pull-request threads across 1,774 open-source MCP repositories. translated_title: 真实MCP故障下的工具调用LLM智能体：模型规模并不能换来容错能力
translated_abstract: LLM智能体日益依赖通过模型上下文协议暴露的外部工具，然而当前的基准测试假设工具能够正确且及时地响应，使得智能体对现实中工具故障的韧性从未得到检验。我们提出了MCP-Injector，一种即插即用、协议感知的故障注入中间件，它能够介入MCP工具调用路径，支持受控的故障持久性类型（永久性、瞬时性、间歇性）以及可种子化的故障调度。其故障模型根据公共MCP生态系统中观察到的故障分布（故障模式×持久性）进行校准，这些数据来自对1,774个开源MCP仓库中57,240条议题和拉取请求线程的挖掘。在一项跨越两种骨干模型规模（20B、120B）、三种智能体框架（自定义多轮规划-执行框架、OpenAI Agents SDK、LangChain）以及三种故障注入条件的1,350个实验单元的大规模实验中，我们发现从这种以永久性故障为主的压力特征中注入的故障会导致严重的质量下降……
tldr: 提出基于真实MCP生态故障数据校准的故障注入中间件MCP-Injector，实验证明扩大LLM模型规模并不能提升智能体应对工具故障的容错能力。
en_tdlr: We introduce MCP-Injector, a protocol-aware fault-injection middleware calibrated to real-world MCP incident data, and show through large-scale experiments that scaling up LLM backbone size does not purchase fault tolerance for tool-calling agents.
